memory.unit: encoding seed blocks; all declared within-seed cells required; no sample/probe pseudoreplication
notes: Intervals quantify this sampling design; they do not establish consciousness.
One deterministic clone is not an independent replicate.
Missing values are excluded per metric and reported, never replaced by zero.
memory.inference: two predeclared primary contrasts, Holm correction across both; conditional on fixed materials
